properties.name: North Ridge Landslide Zone
properties.description: Steep slopes with loose soil composition. Historical landslide events recorded every monsoon season since 2010. High risk to habitations H001, H003, H007, H008, H012, H014.

properties.name: River Basin Flood Zone
properties.description: Low-lying river basin prone to seasonal flooding. River overflow affects habitations H002, H006, H009, H013, H017, H019. Flood depth can reach 2-3 meters during extreme events.

properties.name: Upper Valley Cloudburst Corridor
properties.description: Orographic cloudburst zone in upper valley. Intense localized rainfall (>100mm/hr) causes flash floods. Affects habitations H005, H010, H015. Limited early warning time.

properties.name: Eastern Coastal Erosion Belt
properties.description: Active coastal erosion zone with shoreline retreat of 1-2m/year. Cyclone events accelerate erosion. Threatens habitations H004, H011, H016. Saltwater intrusion affects groundwater.

properties.name: Western Slope Instability Zone
properties.description: Moderate slope instability with weathered rock. Rockfall and debris flow risk during intense rainfall. Proximity to habitations H003, H007, H014, H020.

properties.name: Central Floodplain
properties.description: Broad floodplain with moderate flood risk. Agricultural land use provides some buffer. Affects habitations H006, H009, H013, H019. Drainage infrastructure partially mitigates risk.

properties.name: High Altitude Cloudburst Zone
properties.description: High altitude cloudburst prone area. Rapid snowmelt combined with intense rainfall causes destructive flash floods. Impacts H010, H015. Difficult access for emergency response.

properties.name: Southern Coastal Vulnerability Zone
properties.description: Vulnerable coastal stretch with mangrove degradation. Storm surges cause temporary inundation and permanent erosion. Affects H011, H016. Community depends on fishing livelihoods.

properties.name: Eastern Escarpment Slide Area
properties.description: Escarpment with history of seismic-triggered landslides. Jointed rock mass with adverse dip. Threatens H008, H012. Road access frequently blocked.

properties.name: Estuarine Flood Risk Zone
properties.description: Estuarine area with compound flood risk from high tides and river discharge. Moderate risk to H002, H009. Tidal gates provide partial protection.
